warmup.title: Match Preparation
warmup.section1Goal: Goal: Create a positive atmosphere and review the day's agenda.
section1Points: High fives, fist bumps, check-ins – sharing how everyone is doing.
Day's themes (max 3, e.g.): Enjoy, Compete, Dribble or Pass.
Themes based on training – can vary, but "Enjoy" is always included.
warmup.section2Goal: Goal: Raise body temperature, tune minds for the game.
section2Activities: Two lines + marker 5m away (cone/vest), circle around outside to the back of own line.
Jump to partner's side (2 times per movement).
Animal movements: inchworm, bear walk, duck walk (kids can suggest).
Sprints (approx. 5): standing start, sitting start, push-up start.
warmup.section3Goal: Goal: Activate ball touch and prepare for the game.
section3PairWorkPoints: Basic passing close → further away (game stance, balls of feet, inside foot, care).
section3GoalieWarmupPoints: Throws/passes from close (2m) and further away:
Up, side, air, ground (getting used to the ball).
section3CombinedGoalieWarmupPoints: GK in goal → wall pass → shot from 16m / between pen. spot & box (coach can be wall).
warmup.section4Goal: Goal: Final preparations before the game.
section4Points: Timing just before entering the field (game leader ready).
duringGamePoints: Encourage good plays (e.g., fist bumps, "Yes!", "Just like we practiced!").
Let the player make their own decisions – guide only off-the-ball players and subs if needed.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy for MatchOps

dataController.title: Data Controller
dataController.content: MatchOps is developed and operated by Ville Pajala, based in Finland. We are the controller of your account data (your email, settings, consent records) and of the error reports and usage statistics described below. For the personal data entered about other people (players, staff), the controller is the coach who uses the app - or the club, if the coach uses the app as part of the club's activity - and we act as processor (see Data Processing in the Terms of Service).

overview.title: Overview
overview.content: MatchOps ("we", "our", "the app") is a soccer coaching application that uses secure cloud sync. This privacy policy explains how we handle your information.

dataStorage.title: Data Storage
dataStorage.localDataIntro: Your data is also stored on your device for offline use, including:

localDataItems.personnelInfo: Personnel information (names, roles, contact details if you choose to enter them)

dataStorage.localDataNote: This on-device copy is protected by your device and is not directly accessible to us. The synced copy is stored in your private cloud account (see Cloud Sync below).
dataStorage.noAccountContent: Using the app requires creating an account and signing in. Providing your email address to create the account is necessary to deliver the app and its cloud sync, and the service cannot be provided without it. Any other personal data you enter (players, personnel, game records) is provided at your own discretion.
dataStorage.cloudDataIntro: Your data is stored on our secure cloud servers:

cloudDataItems.syncedData: Stored on Supabase servers in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden)
cloudDataItems.encryption: Encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest
cloudDataItems.rowLevelSecurity: Protected by row-level security: through the app, each account can reach only its own data

dataStorage.cloudDataNote: Cloud data is stored in EU data centres (Stockholm, Sweden). You can delete your cloud data or your whole account at any time in Settings → Data.
dataStorage.dataRetentionContent: Your cloud data is kept while your account exists. When you delete your cloud data or your account (Settings → Data), it is removed from the live database immediately; any copy in our encrypted nightly database backups (stored in the EU with Cloudflare R2) is removed when that backup expires (at most 30 days). Deleting your account also deletes your consent records. If an account is unused for a long time, we may delete its cloud data after notifying you first. Data on your device stays there until you delete it or clear the app's storage. Error reports are deleted by Sentry automatically within at most 90 days. Deleting only your cloud data keeps your account's feature and content access records (see Access to Extra Features and Content); they are deleted with your account.
dataStorage.operatorAccess: Who can see your data: you. As the operator we technically have administrator access to the database, but we do not look at your content. We access it only when you ask us to (for example to solve a problem you report) or when the law requires it.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Data Processing (GDPR Art. 6)
legalBasis.intro: We process personal data on the following legal bases:
legalBasis.contract: Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)): providing the service you signed up for - your account and email address, storing and syncing your data, and the account emails the service needs (sign-up confirmation, password reset).
legalBasis.consent: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): only for marketing emails (see Marketing Emails) and for connecting your own AI provider (see Voice Notes and Optional AI). You can withdraw consent at any time; withdrawal does not affect earlier processing.
legalBasis.legitimateInterest: Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): error reporting via Sentry to find and fix bugs, and onboarding milestones to improve how new coaches get started - both can be turned off in Settings → Data → Error reporting and usage statistics. Keeping the record of your acceptance of the Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy is also based on our legitimate interest in being able to demonstrate it (accountability, Art. 5(2)). None of this involves profiling or tracking, and we make no automated decisions about you.

dataWeCollect.title: Data We May Collect
dataWeCollect.errorReportingIntro: Unless you turn it off, Sentry receives the following from the app:

errorReportingItems.errorType: When an error happens: the error type and stack trace
errorReportingItems.deviceType: Device type, browser and operating system version
errorReportingItems.sessionInfo: A pseudonymous session identifier, not linked to your account or email
errorReportingItems.replay: When an error happens: a replay of the screen in the moments before it, with all text and images masked
errorReportingItems.performance: Performance traces for a sample of page loads and screen changes (about 1 in 10): timings and the app address visited

dataWeCollect.errorReportingNote: This is pseudonymous data, not anonymous. We use it only to find and fix bugs and keep the app fast. Reports are built to leave out your game data and player information: text and images are masked in replays, and keys, sign-in data and email addresses are scrubbed before sending. Error reports are processed and stored by Sentry in the EU (Germany). You can turn this off at any time in Settings → Data → Error reporting and usage statistics; from then on the app on your device sends Sentry no error reports or usage statistics. Our servers report their own errors to Sentry separately; those reports contain no account data.
dataWeCollect.licenseValidationContent: The app is free. We process no payments and no payment or licence information.
dataWeCollect.consentTrackingIntro: When you accept the Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy, or grant or withdraw marketing consent, we record:

consentTrackingItems.policyVersion: Which policy version was in force
consentTrackingItems.consentType: What you accepted, granted or withdrew (terms and privacy, or marketing emails)

dataWeCollect.consentTrackingNote: We keep these records to be able to demonstrate your acceptance and your marketing choices (GDPR Art. 5(2) and 7(1)) while your account exists. They are deleted together with your account and are included in your data export.
dataWeCollect.personnelDataIntro: When you add team personnel (coaches, assistants, medical staff), you may optionally enter:
dataWeCollect.personnelDataNote: This data is stored on your device and synced to your cloud account in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden). Staff contact details (email, phone) are personal data under GDPR. For any personal data you enter about other people (such as players and staff), you - or the club you act for - are the controller and are responsible for having a lawful basis to store it and for informing the people concerned; we process it only on your behalf (see Data Processing in the Terms of Service).
dataWeCollect.onboardingContent: Unless you turn it off, we store a few timestamps about your onboarding progress (account created, setup finished or skipped, first plan seen, first and second match finished, switch to the Full view) in your account settings, together with your chosen layout (Basic view or Full view). We use the timestamps only to improve how new coaches get started. They contain none of your game data, are never shared or sold, and are deleted with your account. To object, turn off Settings → Data → Error reporting and usage statistics: no further timestamps are then recorded. The layout is a setting of the app and is always kept. So are the layout notice's marks (layout notice shown and when, and your choice Don't show again), because without them the notice would repeat.
dataWeCollect.featureAccessTitle: Access to Extra Features and Content
dataWeCollect.featureAccessContent: If a feature or a club's content (such as a club's playbook) is switched on for your account, we store that with your account: which feature or content, and when it was switched on. If you enter a club code, we store how many invalid codes your account has entered in the past hour and when that hour began, only to stop code guessing. These records contain none of your game data and are never shared or sold. They are kept when you delete only your cloud data, so access you were given does not disappear, and they are deleted with your account.

dataWeDoNotCollect.title: What We Do Not Do With Your Data

items.gameContent: Your games, scores and statistics: we store them only to provide the app and its sync. We never use, analyse, share or sell them.
items.location: Your device's location: the app never reads it (no GPS). Places you choose to save - match venues and your team's starting point, with their address and map pin - are stored as part of your data to show travel and departure times. Searching for a place sends the text you type to Photon, and filling in a missing venue address sends that saved pin's coordinates (see Third-Party Services and Recipients).
items.photos: Photos or media: the app does not collect them.
items.deviceIds: Tracking or advertising: the app has no ads and no advertising or analytics trackers, and uses no device identifiers for them.
items.playerNames: Player names, notes and other details about people: the same - stored only to provide the sync, never used, analysed, shared or sold.

dataWeDoNotCollect.personnelNote: Note: staff contact details (email, phone) you enter are stored by your choice and under your control - see Personnel Data above.

thirdPartyServices.title: Third-Party Services and Recipients
thirdPartyServices.intro: Supabase, Sentry, Resend, Vercel and Cloudflare (encrypted database backups, EU) are our sub-processors; data processing agreements are in place with each of them. Messages you send to our support email pass through Cloudflare and Google (see Support email below). Google Play, Photon, palloliitto.fi and an AI provider you connect are not our sub-processors: they receive data directly from your device, only when you use them (for Photon, also the automatic venue address lookup described below), under their own terms.
thirdPartyServices.sentryDesc: Error reports, error replays and performance traces from the app on your device, unless you turn them off; error reports from our servers, which contain no account data (EU, Germany).
thirdPartyServices.supabaseDesc: Cloud database and authentication, hosted in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden).
thirdPartyServices.vercelDesc: Hosting of the app and the website. Like any web host it processes your IP address in its request logs (global edge network, Standard Contractual Clauses). The app's server functions run in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden).
thirdPartyServices.photonDesc: Place search in the match venue field and the starting-point field (Settings): it receives the text you type. When a saved venue has a map pin but no address, the app also sends that pin's coordinates to Photon in the background to fill in the address. Photon never receives player data, account details or your device's location; like any web service, it sees your device's IP address (EU, Germany).
thirdPartyServices.openai: OpenAI, or the AI provider you connect
thirdPartyServices.openaiDesc: Only if you connect your own account: the voice notes and text you choose to send go to that provider under your own key. We hold no key and see no content (see Voice notes and AI).
thirdPartyServices.palloliittoDesc: The rulebook PDF is fetched from their site when you open a law; they see the request as they would any website visit (IP address), nothing else.
thirdPartyServices.resendDesc: Sends the account emails (sign-up confirmation, password reset) from noreply@auth.match-ops.com and, if you opt in, marketing emails. It receives your email address and the message (sent and processed in the EU, Ireland).
thirdPartyServices.supportEmailDesc: Messages you send to hello@match-ops.com or support@match-ops.com are forwarded by Cloudflare Email Routing to a Gmail inbox (Google), where we read and keep them to reply to you. They may be processed outside the EU, for example in the US. Please don't include players' details unless needed.

yourRights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
yourRights.intro: Under GDPR and applicable data protection laws, you have the right to:
yourRights.access: Access (Art. 15): export all your data at any time in Settings → Data → Backup & Export - your games, players, staff, settings, your account email and your consent records
yourRights.rectification: Rectification (Art. 16): correct your data directly in the app
yourRights.erasure: Erasure (Art. 17): delete the data on your device, your cloud data or your whole account at any time in Settings → Data
yourRights.portability: Portability (Art. 20): the export is a standard JSON file you can take elsewhere
yourRights.restriction: Restriction (Art. 18): ask us to limit how we process your data by emailing support@match-ops.com
yourRights.objection: Objection (Art. 21): turn off Settings → Data → Error reporting and usage statistics - error reports and onboarding milestones then stop for your account. For any other objection, email support@match-ops.com
yourRights.withdrawConsent: Withdraw consent (Art. 7(3)): withdraw marketing consent in Settings → Account → Email Preferences, and disconnect an AI provider in Settings at any time
yourRights.deleteLocal: Data on this device: Settings → Data
yourRights.deleteCloud: Cloud data and your account: Settings → Data
yourRights.contactUs: Most rights can be used directly in the app under Settings → Data. For anything else, email support@match-ops.com.
yourRights.supervisoryAuthority: If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. In Finland: Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (Tietosuojavaltuutetun toimisto)

childrensPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.content: MatchOps is a tool for adult coaches, not for children. Players do not use the app: the coach enters player names, statistics and notes. That data is stored on the coach's device and in the coach's cloud account in the EU only to provide the service, and we never send it to third parties other than our sub-processors listed above - except when the coach connects their own AI provider and chooses to send notes or recordings to it (see Voice Notes and Optional AI). Venue search text and saved venue pin coordinates can go to Photon for place search and address lookup; no player data does. The coach - or the club, if the coach uses the app as part of the club's activity - is the controller of the player data and is responsible for informing players' families; Settings → Data has a ready-made notice for that. Families can ask the coach to delete the data and can lodge a complaint with the Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (tietosuoja.fi).

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.localIntro: On your device, your data is stored in the browser's IndexedDB database:

localItems.deviceProtection: Protected by your device's access controls (screen lock, password, biometrics)
localItems.noAdditionalEncryption: Not additionally encrypted at rest beyond what your device/browser provides
localItems.noTransmission: The on-device copy is only transmitted when syncing to your private cloud account, over an encrypted connection

dataSecurity.localNote: Your device's security is your primary protection for local data. We recommend using a strong screen lock.
dataSecurity.cloudIntro: In your cloud account, your data is protected by:

cloudItems.atRestEncryption: Encryption at rest on Supabase servers in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden)
cloudItems.rowLevelSecurity: Row-level security ensuring you can only access your own data
cloudItems.soc2: Backed by Supabase's security infrastructure and SOC 2 compliance

dataSecurity.backupContent: When you export your data, the file contains all of it, including staff contact details, your account email and your consent records. Export files are not encrypted, so store them somewhere safe and delete copies you no longer need.

voiceNotesAndAi.title: Voice Notes and Optional AI
voiceNotesAndAi.intro: MatchOps can record short voice notes during a game. You listen to a recording and write the note yourself. This is how they are handled:

items.onDevice: Recordings are stored only on your device. They are never uploaded to MatchOps servers, never synced between devices, and never included in backups or exports.
items.deleted: A recording is deleted from your device as soon as you turn it into a note or discard it, and in any case after 30 days.
items.notes: The written notes you save become part of the game record and are handled like all other game data described above (stored on your device and, in cloud mode, synced to your account).
items.neverReceived: MatchOps never receives your recordings. Notes and report text you choose to save are game data and are handled as described above.

voiceNotesAndAi.aiIntro: This is an experimental feature that is currently hidden and not in normal use; without it, nothing is transcribed or sent to any AI service. When it is turned on, you may connect your own account with an AI provider (for example OpenAI) to transcribe recordings, draft or tidy match reports, translate a report, and read back your own notes about one player as prose. If you do:

aiItems.yourAccount: Data is sent directly from your device to the provider you chose, under your own account and your own API key. MatchOps is not a party to that processing and has no access to it.
aiItems.onlyOnAction: Nothing is sent automatically. Data leaves your device only when you press a button that says so (Transcribe, Draft, Tidy, Translate, Group these notes), and the app tells you what it is about to send first.
aiItems.providerTerms: The provider processes and retains data under its own terms, which you accepted when you created the account. MatchOps has no control over that retention.
aiItems.pseudonymized: Before drafting requests, player names are replaced with codes on your device (on by default). Transcription requests necessarily contain the words you spoke, and the first names of the players in that match are sent with them so the service spells them correctly.
aiItems.disconnect: You can disconnect the provider and delete all recordings at any time from Settings. The key is stored only on your device.

marketing.title: Marketing Emails
marketing.content: Only if you opt in, we send occasional emails about new features and tips to your account email. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)). You can withdraw it at any time in Settings → Account → Email Preferences; each grant and withdrawal is recorded (see Consent Records). The emails are sent through Resend. Without your consent we send only the account emails the service needs (sign-up confirmation, password reset).

voiceNotesInfo.title: What leaves the phone
voiceNotesInfo.subtitle: For families: how a coach's notes, voice notes and the optional AI features in MatchOps handle information about players.
voiceNotesInfo.keeps1: Short notes about football, written or dictated on the coach's own phone during and after games: what went well, what the team is working on.
voiceNotesInfo.keeps2: The notes stay in the coach's app on that phone. If the coach uses MatchOps with an account, they are also stored in the coach's own cloud account, like the rest of the match data.
voiceNotesInfo.keeps3: The coach is responsible for these notes, the same as for a paper notebook. The app's rules tell coaches to keep to football actions and first names, and never to note health, family or personal matters.
voiceNotesInfo.recordings1: A recording stays on the coach's phone. It is never sent to MatchOps, never synced to another device, and never included in backups.
voiceNotesInfo.recordings2: It is deleted from the phone as soon as it has been turned into a note or discarded, and in any case after 30 days.
voiceNotesInfo.aiTitle: If the coach uses the optional AI
voiceNotesInfo.aiIntro: Turning a recording into text and drafting a match report can use an AI service. This is an experimental feature that is off by default and hidden in the app; without it, the coach listens to the recording and types the note. AI is used only if the coach turns the experimental feature on and connects their own account with a provider (for example OpenAI), and only when the coach presses a button. MatchOps, the app's maker, never sees any of it.
voiceNotesInfo.ai1: Before a report is drafted, players' names are replaced with codes such as P1 and P2 on the phone. The provider does not receive the names.
voiceNotesInfo.ai2: When a recording is turned into text, the recording itself is sent, together with the first names of the players in that match so they are spelled correctly.
voiceNotesInfo.ai3: The provider keeps what it receives for a limited time under its own terms. For OpenAI's API: not used to train models, kept at most 30 days for abuse monitoring.
voiceNotesInfo.ai4: Whatever the AI writes is a draft. The coach reads it and decides what, if anything, is saved.
voiceNotesInfo.ai5: The coach can disconnect the provider and delete every recording at any time.
voiceNotesInfo.rights1: Ask the coach what has been noted about your child. The coach can show it to you.
voiceNotesInfo.rights2: Ask the coach to delete it. Notes and recordings can be deleted at any time.
voiceNotesInfo.rights3: Questions about the app itself go to MatchOps; the contact details are in the privacy policy.
voiceNotesInfo.asOf: This page describes MatchOps as of November 2026.

dataProcessing.title: Data Processing (GDPR Art. 28)
dataProcessing.intro: This section is the data processing agreement between you and us under GDPR Art. 28(3). It is based on the standard contractual clauses between controllers and processors adopted by the European Commission in Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/915, and it applies whenever you enter personal data about other people (players and staff).

items.roles: Roles: you - or the club you act for - are the controller of that data. MatchOps (Ville Pajala) is your processor.
items.scope: Subject, nature and duration: storing, syncing and showing the data you enter (such as names, shirt numbers, positions, match events, statistics, notes and staff contact details) about the players and staff of your teams, for as long as your account exists.
items.instructions: Instructions: we process the data only to provide the service, on your documented instructions - these Terms and the actions you take in the app - unless EU or Finnish law requires otherwise; in that case we tell you first, unless the law forbids it.
items.confidentiality: Confidentiality: everyone authorised to process the data on our behalf is bound by confidentiality. We do not look at your content except when you ask us to or the law requires it.
items.security: Security (Art. 32): the data is hosted in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden), encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest, and separated per account by row-level security. If a personal data breach affects your data, we notify you without undue delay.
items.subprocessors: Sub-processors: you give general authorisation for Supabase (database and authentication, EU), Sentry (error reporting, EU), Resend (account emails, EU) and Vercel (hosting). We bind them by contract to the same data protection obligations. We tell you about any intended addition or replacement in advance by updating this list and the Privacy Policy, so you can object; if you object, you can stop using the service and delete your account.
items.assistance: Assistance: the app lets you access, correct, export and delete the data yourself, which is how we help you answer requests from the people concerned. As far as the nature of the processing allows, we also help you with security, breach notification and impact assessments.
items.deletion: End of the service: when you delete your account, we delete the data (see the Privacy Policy for backups). You can export it at any time before that.
items.compliance: Demonstrating compliance: on request to support@match-ops.com, we make available the information needed to demonstrate that these obligations are met, and allow and contribute to reasonable audits.

aiSettings.parentText: Hi! As the coach I keep short notes about the players during and after games - who did what well, what we are working on. The notes are written or dictated on my phone and stay in my coaching app. I use my own AI service (OpenAI, processed in the US) to turn dictated notes into text and to draft match reports. For transcription, the voice recording and the first names of the players in that match are sent to the service so the names are spelled correctly. aiConsent.title: Before you connect an AI provider
aiConsent.data1: Recordings stay on this phone. MatchOps never receives your audio.
aiConsent.data2: When you press Transcribe or Draft, the recording or notes are sent from this phone to the AI provider YOU connected, under YOUR account and YOUR key.
aiConsent.data3: The provider may keep the data for a limited time under its own terms (OpenAI: not used for training, abuse-monitoring logs up to 30 days, processed in the US). Read your provider's terms - MatchOps is not a party to them.
aiConsent.data4: Costs are billed to your provider account. Create a dedicated key with a monthly spend cap.
aiConsent.data5: Player names are replaced with codes before any drafting request (you can turn this off). Transcription necessarily contains what you said, and the first names of the players in that match are sent with the audio so the provider spells them correctly.
aiConsent.data6: You can disconnect the provider and delete all recordings at any time from Settings.
aiConsent.rule1: Talk about football actions, not people's lives.
aiConsent.rule2: Use first names or nicknames, never full names.
aiConsent.rule3: Never dictate health, injuries, family matters, or anything about parents, referees or opponents by name.
aiConsent.rule4: Keep clips short; delete anything you would not want a parent to read.
aiConsent.rule5: You are responsible for what you dictate and for informing families where your situation requires it.
aiConsent.box1: I understand recordings and notes go to my own AI provider, under my account, and MatchOps never receives them.
aiConsent.box2: I have read my provider's data terms and accept that they may retain data for a limited time.
aiConsent.box3: I will follow the dictation rules and not dictate health or other sensitive data.
aiConsent.data1b: A note or report you choose to SAVE is ordinary match data from then on. If you use MatchOps with an account, it syncs and is backed up like the rest of your match notes.

privacySettings.title: Privacy
privacySettings.diagnosticsHint: Sends error reports to help fix bugs and records when you reach the first onboarding steps. Never your game data. Turning this off stops both for your account.
privacySettings.familyNoticeHint: A ready-made message you can send to families: what the app stores about players, why, where and for how long, and who to ask.
privacySettings.familyNoticeText: Hi! As the coach I use the MatchOps app to run the team. The controller of the players' data is me as the coach - or the club, if I use the app as part of the club's activity. In the app I store each player's first name or nickname, shirt number, positions, playing time and planned playing time, goals, assists and other match events, and short coaching notes. If I record a voice note during a match, the recording stays only on my phone: it is not sent to MatchOps or anyone else, not synced and not backed up, and it is deleted once I have written the note, or after 30 days at the latest. The app's AI features are experimental and off; I would use them only if I turned them on myself with my own AI service, and I would tell you about it first. I use this information only to coach the team: line-ups, planning playing time and match statistics. It is kept on my phone and in my coaching account, on a server in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden). It is not shared with anyone else, sold or used for advertising, and I do not record health information. I keep it while I coach the team and delete it when it is no longer needed. You can ask me at any time what has been stored about your child and ask me to correct or delete it - deletion requests go to me, the coach. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority, the Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman in Finland (tietosuoja.fi).
